text:
**Short answer:** The Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand is the best all-rounder. If you have a recent iPhone and want 25W, the ESR CryoBoost is the better value.

**Top picks**

1. **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (best overall, per WIRED).** It has a chrome "tree" design, charges the iPhone at up to 15W, and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The AirPods sit on the base, and the iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. WIRED lists it at $98 (list $109), with $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy at the time of writing. I don't have a direct product link in these results, so check the [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) for the current shop links.

2. **ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W (fastest, good value).** It charges at the full 25W and has an active cooling fan. It includes a 50W adapter, and ESR gives a 30-day return window and a 12-month warranty (24 months if you register).
   - It's $99.99 at ESR's US store. Dealectric says code PARTNER18 took $17.99 off in its test cart on Oct 23, bringing it to about $82. Checkout has the final say.
   - 25W only applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.
   - ESR doesn't publish the stand's dimensions.
   - [Buy via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). The [product page](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) has details. WIRED's travel guide also lists it as the fastest in its category.

3. **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Stand, Qi2 25W (best for desk use).** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has seen. It comes with a 45W adapter, and it folds flat for travel. It costs $129.99, which is the priciest of the group. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

4. **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Station, Qi2 (best for travel).** It folds slim, charges the iPhone at 15W, and has a 2-year warranty. WIRED lists it at $80 (down from $110). It can feel crowded when fully loaded. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**Budget option:** WIRED's cheap pick is the ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station, listed at $40 on Amazon (marked down from $80). That is probably the 15W model, so confirm the specs on the listing. [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Which to choose**
- **Nightstand charging:** 15W is plenty. WIRED notes 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the Belkin or Anker is enough.
- **Fast top-ups on an iPhone 16 Plus, 16 Pro Max or 17:** get the ESR CryoBoost or Satechi.
- **Frequent travel:** get the Anker or Satechi, since both fold.

I can't verify live prices, so check the final price at checkout.
